Open your eyes. They are trying to sell you the official cover story that Bill C-12, officially titled the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, is just standard policy receiving royal assent on March 26, 2026. Don't fall for it. 

When the hidden establishment claims they are merely tightening immigration and asylum rules against Nigerians, others, it is a complete smokescreen. This is a carefully coordinated maneuver by the elites to reshape populations and control the narrative. Every official justification they give is an exact inversion of the truth. They are orchestrating these border clampdowns to serve a deeper, concealed agenda that they refuse to confess to the public.
